rationale: DOJ investigates TV networks over Trump pool coverage — confirmed antitrust probe into press access; Isaias becomes first Atlantic hurricane threatening Gulf Coast with confirmed landfall risk.

top_events.title: US justice department investigates TV networks over Trump pool coverage
top_events.label: DOJ probes networks over Trump pool coverage
top_events.summary: Justice Department launches antitrust investigation after White House blocked CNN, MS Now, and Politico access, leading networks to restrict pool coverage. Confirmed federal probe into press access.

top_events.title: Isaias strengthens to become first Atlantic hurricane of 2026 season
top_events.label: Isaias becomes first Atlantic hurricane of 2026
top_events.summary: First Atlantic hurricane of season expected to make landfall on northern Gulf Coast with flash flood and river flooding risk. Confirmed threat to US coastal communities.

top_events.title: US murderer Christa Pike discharged from hospital 10 days after failed execution
top_events.label: Pike discharged after surviving failed execution
top_events.summary: Death row inmate discharged after surviving two lethal injections last month. Ongoing legal and medical questions over execution protocol, no immediate policy change.
